markets.name: the United States
markets.context: Long-haul travel to India, large time-zone gap (roughly 9.5 to 13.5 hours), planning calls scheduled around US evenings/mornings, holiday windows such as Thanksgiving and winter break shaping wedding dates.

markets.name: the United Kingdom
markets.context: Direct and one-stop flights to Indian cities, a 4.5 to 5.5 hour time difference, school-holiday windows and Christmas/New Year travel, large multi-generational guest lists.

markets.name: the UAE and Gulf
markets.context: Short flights to India, small time difference, weekend structure (Friday/Saturday) affecting travel, many families with strong ties to specific Indian regions.

markets.name: Canada
markets.context: Long-haul travel, large time-zone gap, winter travel windows, large Punjabi and Gujarati communities.

markets.name: Australia
markets.context: Long flights, a 4.5 to 5.5 hour time difference depending on region and daylight saving, planning around the Indian wedding season and southern-hemisphere holidays.

markets.name: Singapore
markets.context: Relatively short flights to India, small time difference, compact families who often travel as one group.
